fray.translation:
n. 磨损, 打架, 争论
vt. 使磨损
vi. 被磨损

frayed.definition: s. worn away or tattered along the edges
frayed.translation:
a. 磨损的
v. （使布、绳等）磨损, 磨破( fray的过去式和过去分词 )

fraying.definition:
v wear away by rubbing
v cause friction
fraying.translation: n. 织物磨损后落下的碎片, 磨擦后落下的东西

frays.definition:
n a noisy fight
v wear away by rubbing
v cause friction
frays.translation:
n. （使布、绳等）磨损, 磨破( fray的名词复数 )
v. （使布、绳等）磨损, 磨破( fray的第三人称单数 )
